facts.statement: Customer says “your work was unacceptable; water damaged our office and the electrical plant may still be unsafe”. They do not say complaint. Root cause/liability unverified; failed component, photos and original worksheet are relevant evidence.

Coordinator Casey has no settlement authority. Proposed £100 goodwill is not authorised; safety actions are incomplete. Susan owns insurer-policy notification verification; Service Manager owns complaint communication at 12:00.
